title: Cyberussell — AI Career Platform
tagline: A free platform helping Filipinos find online income paths using AI-powered tools and step-by-step career blueprints.
overview: Cyberussell is a free, AI-powered platform built to help Filipinos discover realistic online income paths. It combines a Skill Finder quiz, dozens of step-by-step Career Blueprints, and free AI tools (scam checker, prompt trainer, bio generator) into one guided experience.
problem: Most Filipinos looking to earn online face the same wall: too much scattered, outdated, or scammy advice, and no clear starting point that matches their actual skills and situation.
solution: Built a single platform that starts with a short assessment, matches the user to a specific income path, then hands them a complete blueprint — roadmap, tools, platforms, and today's mission — instead of generic advice.
results: Launched and actively growing, with a full library of career blueprints, free AI tools, and a content engine feeding new visitors through blog and social content.
